the liberalization of the Vietnamese rice market in the 1980s and 1990s has had the following impacts on rice production: (1) the steady-state level of rice production is increased; (2) the transitional growth rate is increased, especially in the second stage; and (3) the steady-state rate of growth in rice production is increased.

(1) liberalisation increases the steady-state level of capital and output in Vietnam’s rice sector; (2) the incentive effect is the most important factor that drives the increase in capital and output; (3) the transitional growth rate is also significantly higher in the second stage of liberalization than that in the first stage; and (4) the transitional growth of output is significantly higher in the incentive effect scenario than that in the no-incentive scenario.
